profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Highly motivated and goal-oriented Electrical & Computer Engineering graduate with extensive experience in Embedded Systems and Software Development, outstanding problem solving and communication skills with the ability to multi-task, self-manage daily responsibilities, meet deadlines and curiosity to acquire new skills. Ease of adaption to different environments and people due to large experience living abroad.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Embedded software engineer for Tensor Processing Units (TPU), Google's custom-designed ASIC accelerators for ML computation.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software in C for Battery Management Systems (BMS) solutions on Infineon 32-bit TriCore-TC264 MCU, low-level drivers (ADC, DIO, PWM, I2C, SPI) and system functionalities (HV Isolation, Contactor Drivers, CAN, Wake/Shutdown, NvM, Bootloader) following ISO26262 Functional Safety Standards.

Launched first BMS Production of the company leading the End of Line software development, coordinated the manufacturing process with CM in China, releasing over 10K units to one of the largest car manufacturers in China - EVs are currently operating in the market.

Board bring-up and EOL development for the Production of 1K sample boards for 4 different customers used for testing and validation in-vehicle to enable large-scale contracts.

C# .NET application development to fully automate the integration and compilation process following AUTOSAR architecture through ETAS Toolchain, generating output images directly to the customer.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software for ARM and Freescale processors in C/C++ language for new and existing products. Implemented a FreeRTOS architecture into embedded systems.

Led the development of the DSS-5000 Battery Diagnostic Service Station, receiving $20M in PO from several top car manufacturers.

Developed low-level drivers, system and application software, understanding of hardware schematics, communication protocols, documentation and specification.

Debugged and troubleshooted communication protocols (TCP/IP), Wi-Fi and BT connections and low-level interfaces (CAN, I2C).

Developed C/C++ and C# .NET applications to speed up testing and reduce amount of escaped defects. Worked on test automation systems in Arduino boards.

positions.title: Research Student
positions.description:
Research Student for Image Processing applied to Object Recognition.

Shape and color recognition for a UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) competition.

Combined C/C++ language with Intel's open source library OpenCV. Further implementation of the system in an FPGA.

Research of the impact of Neural Networks in object recognition.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Tested road Doppler radar devices, including image processing, pattern recognition software and data storage.

honors.title: UPM Scolarship
honors.description: Selected to receive an academic scholarship to pursue a Master's degree at Illinois Institute of Technology.

volunteerExperiences.description: Participated in food drives for underprivileged children, as well as meal preparation and other charitable activities.

Participated in meal preparation, event planning and organization of birthdays and parties for Senior Residences, Homeless Shelters.

Volunteered in other non-profit organizations such as CF Foundation.

projects.title: Implementation of a MIPS Processor
projects.description:
Design of every component of a MIPS Processor (CPU, Cache and RAM) including memory strategies for block replacement.
Project developed in VHDL Language using Xilinx ISE Design Tool to implement it and run test benchs.

projects.title: Review of the Logic Families Consumption
projects.description:
Review of the leakage current and power consumption for Domino Logic and Split Data Path Driven Dynamic Logic.
Power gating scheme applied in order to reduce leakage.
